title: Crisp Caramelised Sugar Palmiers
summary: Shop-bought all-butter puff pastry rolled in sugar, folded into scrolls and baked until crisp, flaky and caramelised.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Sugar the pastry
steps.text: Mix the sugar with the salt. Sprinkle 3 tbsp over the worktop, lay the pastry on top and sprinkle another 3 tbsp over it.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll the pastry to a rectangle about 28 x 35 cm and 2 mm thick, pressing the sugar into both sides and scattering more underneath if it starts to stick. Trim the ragged edges with the knife.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Fold each short end 2 cm toward the centre, scatter over a little sugar and keep folding until the two folds meet in the middle. Fold one half on top of the other to make a log, wrap it in cling film and chill for 30 min so it slices cleanly.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) with shelves in the upper and lower thirds, and line the trays with baking paper.

steps.title: Slice
steps.text: Cut the log into 20 slices 1 cm thick. Press each cut side into the sugar left in the bowl and space the slices 7 cm apart, as they spread.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 12-14 min, until the edges are light golden. Flip each palmier with the fish slice, swap the trays between shelves and turn them, then bake for 5-8 min more until deep golden and glazed. Watch closely, as the sugar can burn in under a minute.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Leave on the trays for 30 min; they crisp as they cool.

tips: A common mistake is slicing warm dough, which squashes the layers; chill the log until firm.
Check the label so the puff pastry is made with butter for the best flavour.
If the pastry softens while you fold, chill it for 10 min before carrying on.
Pull the trays out as soon as the palmiers are deep amber; the caramel turns bitter fast.
storage: Keep in an airtight tin at room temperature for up to 3 days, or freeze the unsliced log for up to 1 month and bake from frozen, adding 2-3 min.
